How AI Can Help Small Businesses Compete and Grow

How can small businesses think about AI, economic conditions, and growth opportunities? In this Paychex THRIVE podcast episode, host Gene Marks speaks with Kevin Hassett about tariffs, government and private-sector economic data, labor-market trends, and the role AI may play in small-business productivity and competitiveness. The conversation also discusses how businesses can interpret changing economic indicators and why AI is being closely watched for its potential impact on workers and firms. Explore current hiring and wage trends through the Paychex Small Business Employment Watch, learn more about AI for small businesses, or see how Paychex WISE brings AI-powered intelligence into workforce operations.

  • 00:00 - Episode Preview and Guest Introduction
  • 01:16 - Kevin's Background and Path to the White House
  • 03:27 - Tariffs and the Economy
  • 09:12 - Using Government Data vs. Private-Sector Data
  • 15:12 - Why Government Numbers Get Revised
  • 17:22 - The Underreported Positive: Side Gigs & Extra Income
  • 20:00 - AI as a Small Business Game Changer
  • 25:04 - Why AI Hasn't Replaced Humans
